summary: Full end-to-end testing of Signup Bonus Locked Wallet → Scratch Cards + 5% extra bonus feature. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_scratch_rewards.py with 23 tests covering settings validation, happy path (approve → extra+card, idempotent reapprove, scratch, idempotent reject, reversal, re-approve, pending state cancels card), pending-adjustment path (zero balance → pending → auto recover on next credit → admin waive), scratch-amount cap (room-limited at remaining locked), legacy regression (no_bonus skip, no extra), and admin /api/admin/rewards shape — 23/23 PASS when run serially. Frontend: customer scratchtest@example.com flow verified end-to-end (login → PIN → dashboard scratch-cards-section, bonus-wallet-card ‘Signup Bonus · Locked’ with released-so-far note, canvas drag reveals card, done chip ₹20 appears, bonus locked decreases 180→140, wallet page shows SC-/XB- transactions). Admin flow verified at /admin: rewards-setting panel with rw-extra-pct/save (10→reload persists→restore 5), rw-scratch-toggle (OFF→ON), rw-scratch-mode select, and all four tabs rw-tab-{users,cards,extra,adj} with rw-table-* populated (Scratch Tester row visible in Users). Settings restored to defaults (5% / fixed ₹20 / scratch ON).

minor.issue: Default addopts in /app/backend/pytest.ini enables xdist loadscope. Running test_scratch_rewards.py in parallel causes cross-interference because 4 test classes all mutate the same scratchtest@example.com customer state. Must run with `-n 0 -o addopts=` for correctness. Tests pass 100% serially.

critical_code_review_comments: rewards.py:_reverse correctly handles insufficient balance by debiting what's available and inserting a pending_adjustment row with remaining=unmet amount — balance can never go negative (verified test_simulate_zero_balance_and_reject).
rewards.py:apply_pending_adjustments is called from on_lead_approved (after extra credit) and from scratch endpoint, enabling auto-recovery (verified).

rewards.py:on_lead_approved idempotency uses `_extra_net(lid) <= 0` check — correctly skips re-crediting (verified test_idempotent_reapprove). Scratch card is only created once because reversed-but-reapproved only re-issues when active cards don't block (reversed/cancelled are inactive).
Scratch card amount is correctly capped by `remaining - outstanding_cards` so setting scratch_amount=500 produces card of only remaining locked room (verified test_cap_and_release_then_restore).

GET /api/scratch-cards hides cancelled/reversed cards (filter: status in [issued, scratched]) — matches spec that 'Scratch card list for customer must not show cancelled cards' (verified test_pending_cancels_card).
Settings validation PUT /api/admin/rewards/settings correctly rejects percent>100, mode not in {fixed,range}, and negative amounts with 400 (verified).
